validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <state id="p" initial="c">
    <initial>
      <transition target="c"/>
    </initial>
    <state id="c">
      <transition event="go" target="d"/>
    </state>
    <final id="d"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: state cannot use both the `initial` attribute and an `initial` child
notes: a compound state has exactly one default entry description; two forms conflict
diagnostics.help: keep exactly one form of initial configuration
